bank_accounts_business_metadata.name: bank_accounts_business_metadata
bank_accounts_business_metadata.value: "bank_accounts"."type" = 'BUSINESS' OR ("bank_accounts"."business_name" IS NULL AND "bank_accounts"."business_registration_reference" IS NULL)

cash_requests_review_fields.name: cash_requests_review_fields
cash_requests_review_fields.value:
case
      when "cash_requests"."status"::text in ('PENDING', 'CANCELLED') then
        "cash_requests"."reviewed_by" is null and "cash_requests"."reviewed_at" is null and "cash_requests"."rejection_reason" is null
      when "cash_requests"."status" = 'APPROVED' then
        "cash_requests"."reviewed_by" is not null and "cash_requests"."reviewed_at" is not null and "cash_requests"."rejection_reason" is null
      else "cash_requests"."reviewed_by" is not null and "cash_requests"."reviewed_at" is not null
        and "cash_requests"."rejection_reason" is not null and length(trim("cash_requests"."rejection_reason")) > 0
      end

loan_installments_payment_fields.name: loan_installments_payment_fields
loan_installments_payment_fields.value:
(
    "loan_installments"."paid_at" is null and "loan_installments"."paid_amount_minor" is null and "loan_installments"."repayment_transaction_id" is null and "loan_installments"."paid_overdue_interest_minor" = 0
  ) or (
    "loan_installments"."paid_at" is not null and "loan_installments"."paid_amount_minor" is not null and "loan_installments"."repayment_transaction_id" is not null
    and "loan_installments"."paid_overdue_interest_minor" >= 0
    and "loan_installments"."paid_amount_minor" = "loan_installments"."principal_minor" + "loan_installments"."interest_minor" + "loan_installments"."paid_overdue_interest_minor"
  )

loans_review_fields.name: loans_review_fields
loans_review_fields.value:
("loans"."forwarded_at" is null) = ("loans"."forwarded_by" is null)
    and ("loans"."review_started_by" is null or "loans"."review_started_at" is not null)
    and ("loans"."status" <> 'PENDING' or ("loans"."review_started_at" is null and "loans"."forwarded_at" is null))

loans_decision_fields.name: loans_decision_fields
loans_decision_fields.value:
case
    when "loans"."status" in ('PENDING', 'UNDER_REVIEW') then
      "loans"."decided_at" is null and "loans"."decided_by" is null and "loans"."approved_principal_minor" is null and "loans"."rejection_reason" is null
    when "loans"."status" = 'REJECTED' then
      "loans"."decided_at" is not null and "loans"."decided_by" is not null and "loans"."approved_principal_minor" is null
      and "loans"."rejection_reason" is not null and length(trim("loans"."rejection_reason")) > 0
    else "loans"."decided_at" is not null and "loans"."decided_by" is not null and "loans"."rejection_reason" is null
      and "loans"."approved_principal_minor" is not null and "loans"."approved_principal_minor" > 0
  end

loans_approval_reason.name: loans_approval_reason
loans_approval_reason.value: "loans"."approval_reason" is null or ("loans"."status" in ('APPROVED', 'ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED') and length(trim("loans"."approval_reason")) > 0)

loans_disbursement_fields.name: loans_disbursement_fields
loans_disbursement_fields.value:
case
    when "loans"."status" = 'ACTIVE' then "loans"."disbursed_at" is not null and "loans"."completed_at" is null
      and "loans"."remaining_principal_minor" is not null and "loans"."remaining_principal_minor" > 0
      and "loans"."remaining_principal_minor" <= "loans"."approved_principal_minor"
    when "loans"."status" = 'COMPLETED' then "loans"."disbursed_at" is not null and "loans"."completed_at" is not null
      and "loans"."remaining_principal_minor" is not null and "loans"."remaining_principal_minor" = 0
    else "loans"."disbursed_at" is null and "loans"."completed_at" is null and "loans"."remaining_principal_minor" is null
  end

transaction_flags_resolution_fields.name: transaction_flags_resolution_fields

transactions_reversal_fields.name: transactions_reversal_fields
transactions_reversal_fields.value:
case
      when "transactions"."type"::text = 'TRANSFER_REVERSAL' then
        "transactions"."reverses_transaction_id" is not null and "transactions"."reverses_transaction_id" <> "transactions"."id"
        and "transactions"."initiated_by" is not null and "transactions"."status" = 'COMPLETED'
        and "transactions"."reversal_reason" is not null and length(trim("transactions"."reversal_reason")) between 1 and 300
        and "transactions"."refunded_fee_minor" >= 0 and "transactions"."fee_minor" = 0
        and "transactions"."idempotency_key" is null
      else "transactions"."reverses_transaction_id" is null and "transactions"."reversal_reason" is null and "transactions"."refunded_fee_minor" = 0
      end

transactions_account_direction.name: transactions_account_direction
transactions_account_direction.value:
case
        when "transactions"."type"::text in ('FUND_TRANSFER', 'TRANSFER_REVERSAL') then
          "transactions"."sender_account_id" is not null and "transactions"."receiver_account_id" is not null
          and "transactions"."sender_account_id" <> "transactions"."receiver_account_id"
        when "transactions"."type" in ('DEPOSIT', 'LOAN_DISBURSEMENT')
          then "transactions"."sender_account_id" is null and "transactions"."receiver_account_id" is not null
        else "transactions"."sender_account_id" is not null and "transactions"."receiver_account_id" is null
      end

transactions_transfer_identity.name: transactions_transfer_identity
transactions_transfer_identity.value:
("transactions"."idempotency_key" is null or "transactions"."initiated_by" is not null)
        and ("transactions"."type" <> 'FUND_TRANSFER' or "transactions"."idempotency_key" is not null)
